items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: my mom and sister, her name was Pauline. Pauline was a heck of a singer, boy.

ctx.x: Uh, I was wondering, was there any special meals on other holidays like Christmas and Thanksgiving?

Well. Or, uh, yeah, well, well now this is something, you know, I wish a lot of people could have seen. You see, down in Jefferson, Christmas Day. Uh huh. Christmas like was one big holiday. You go to, you go to, uh, you go to church Christmas morning. Uh huh. And then after that, it was one big holiday. You see how it was, they don't do it no more. We do it vaguely, but not as much as they used to. People used to get together in droves and come by your house. You'd have 20, 30 people at one time coming in your…
Did you, would you all sing Christmas carols? Uh, no, it was spiritual songs.
